keyword.en: how to read concrete pump m3/h on a catalogue
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵立方米每小时在目录里怎么写

title.en: How Theoretical Output Is Written on a Pinjin Sheet
title.zh: 品锦参数页怎样书写理论输送量

description.en: Xingtai concrete pump sheets write output as a range, a single figure, or a high and low ceiling. The notation is part of the cell.
description.zh: 邢台混凝土泵把产量写成范围、单个数字，或一高一低两档上限。写法本身属于这一格。

h1.en: How Theoretical Output Is Written on a Pinjin Sheet
h1.zh: 品锦参数页怎样书写理论输送量

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery writes theoretical output in more than one way on its Xingtai concrete pumps. Electric 20 prints a range, 8–10 m³/h. Electric 40 prints a single figure, 21 m³/h. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. LZ-80 prints two ceilings, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. A range is not a promise of the top number, and the ≤ sign is part of the LZ-80 cell.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵上用不止一种写法印理论输送量。电动20是范围 8–10 m³/h。电动40是单个数字 21 m³/h。柴油120是 100 m³/h。LZ-80 是两档上限：高压 ≤ 65 m³/h，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。范围不是顶格承诺，≤ 符号是 LZ-80 格子的一部分。

body.en: Range examples on concrete pumps include Electric 15 at 8–10 m³/h, Electric 30 at 12–15 m³/h, the Tractor-Driven 4100 at 6–12 m³/h and the rural diesel pump at 5–8 m³/h. Single figures include Electric 60 at 40 m³/h and HBT8018 at 60 m³/h. Only LZ-80 uses the paired ≤ ceilings. Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints these in Xingtai. Do not turn a range into a single guaranteed site total.
body.zh: 混凝土泵上的范围例子包括电动15的 8–10 m³/h、电动30的 12–15 m³/h、拖拉机带动4100的 6–12 m³/h 和农村柴油泵的 5–8 m³/h。单值包括电动60的 40 m³/h 和 HBT8018 的 60 m³/h。只有 LZ-80 使用成对的 ≤ 上限。河北品锦机械在邢台印出这些数字。不要把范围改成工地保证总量。

heading.en: A power range is not an output range
heading.zh: 功率范围不是产量范围

body.en: The diesel mixer prints engine 4108 / 66–75 kW and theoretical output 25 m³/h. The 66–75 spread is on the engine line. The output line is a single 25 m³/h. Read the row title before you treat a hyphen as output.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵的发动机为 4108 / 66–75 kW，理论输送量为 25 m³/h。66–75 写在发动机行。产量行是单独的 25 m³/h。把连字符当成产量之前，先看行标题。

heading.en: The model numeral is still not the output
heading.zh: 型号里的数字仍然不是产量

body.en: Electric 10 prints 21 m³/h, not 10. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h, not 80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery's concrete pump names are commercial labels. Open the output cell on /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ rather than reading the badge.
body.zh: 电动10印 21 m³/h，不是 10。柴油30印 15 m³/h，不是 30。电动80印 60 m³/h，不是 80。河北品锦机械的混凝土泵名称是商品标签。请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ 的产量格，而不是只读铭牌。

answer.en: It is the theoretical-output range printed on that concrete pump page, for example Electric 20 and Electric 15. It is not a single guaranteed site total.
answer.zh: 它是该混凝土泵页面印出的理论输送量范围，例如电动20和电动15。它不是单一的工地保证值。

question.en: Which pump uses a less-than-or-equal output?
question.zh: 哪台泵的产量带小于等于号？

answer.en: LZ-80 prints high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Other concrete pumps in this catalogue do not use that paired ceiling.
answer.zh: LZ-80 印高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。本目录其他混凝土泵没有使用这一对上限。

answer.en: No. On the diesel mixer that spread is the engine line. Output on that page is 25 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。在柴油搅拌泵上，这个区间是发动机行。该页产量是 25 m³/h。

question.zh: 电动80的产量是 80 m³/h 吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints 60 m³/h on the Electric 80 page in Xingtai.
answer.zh: 不是。河北品锦机械在邢台的电动80页面印的是 60 m³/h。
